en: Black‑and‑white winter scene showing deep snow along a curving road in a small town. On the left stands a large wooden house with ornate balconies, and several people are visible near the entrance. To the right a substantial truss railway bridge on stone piers crosses above smaller buildings and snowy yards. Leafless trees and fences line the foreground. At the top of the card there is a caption in a Scandinavian language.
